text: EXT. STREET - DAY1 1

YOUNG HALEY DAVIS (7) has beautiful long hair but wears worn-out clothes. She braves the wind and snow, struggles to push a big cart with roses for sale. Her cheeks are red and swollen from the cold but she puts on a brave face. YOUNG HALEYRoses! Fresh roses for sale! She approaches a passing COUPLE. YOUNG HALEY(cont'd)Sir, why not buy a rose for your wife! The passing couple ignores and shoulder-checks Young Haley, sending her off balance. Haley continues walking. The Grocery store owner (MR. JONES) and his wife (MRS. JONES) see her and sigh with sympathy. MR. JONESHaley, I'll take all those flowers. YOUNG HALEY(delighted)Really? Thank you so much, sir! Mr. Jones takes out several bills from his wallet and offers them to Haley. YOUNG HALEY(cont'd)Mr. Jones, that's too much money. MRS. JONESTake it, my sweet child. Go treat yourself to something warm and filling. YOUNG HALEYThank you. Mrs. Jones. Thank you Mr. Jones! Haley skips away. The store owner and his wife exchange concerned looks.

MRS. JONESPoor thing. She should be carefree and happy at this age, but her father died so early and her mother now has cancer... what will become of this widow and her daughter? MR. JONESShe’s just a child, yet she's selling flowers in such cold weather to earn money for her mother's medical bills. It breaks my heart.
INT. JEWELRY STORE - DAY2 2
Young Haley looks at the array of bracelets, remembering something from her past.
Young Haley peeks through the door crack, watching her mother, CLAIRE WINBURY, negotiate with the LANDLORD.

The Landlord examines a ladies' bracelet. LANDLORDThis bracelet is worth $50 at most. Just enough to cover one week’s rent. Claire is thin and pale. She looks disappointed at the offer. CLAIREOnly 50 dollars?(pleading)Sir, could you take a closer look? The Landlord looks uncomfortable as Claire lowers her head. CLAIRE(cont'd)I have stomach cancer, it’s terminal... The Landlord looks surprised. CLAIRE(cont'd)The father of my child died when she was an infant.
No one takes care of her... I just need a little more time to find someone to look after her, then, I can rest in peace ... Please, take another look...
Hearing her mother, Young Haley's very sad, her eyes well up with tears.

The Landlord is moved and examines the bracelet again. CU on the worn bracelet. LANDLORDI'm sorry, I must have been mistaken. This bracelet is worth at least $500. This will pay off your previous debts plus next month’s rent. CLAIRE(crying with joy, bowing)That's enough! One month is enough! Thank you, thank you so much!
Young Haley watches her mother, tears streaming down her face.
INT. HALEY'S HOME - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT16
Claire sleeps while Haley folds her mother's clothes. She discovers several holes in the garments.
CUT TO:

Haley sews the clothes with needle and thread. She pricks her finger, drawing blood. She sucks the blood off and continues sewing. When finished, she admires her work and hugs the clothes tightly to her chest.
INT. EVERFRESH FOOD FACTORY - COURTYARD - DAY - CONTINUOUS22 HALEYI've saved over $40k now. A bit more to go.

Ethan, just wait a little longer - once I reach 50 thousand, we can buy the house and get married! ETHAN(taking Haley's hand)Baby, how about this - transfer the forty thousand to me first. I'll give it to the real estate agent in advance. Then when my parents come to the awards ceremony, I'll invite you on stage and propose to you in front of everyone! HALEY(delighted, sweet)Okay, I'll give you the money right now. Haley hands Ethan a bank card. Ethan takes it and gently pats Haley's head. HALEY(cont'd)The PIN is your birthday. Well, I'm off to sell flowers now. Focus on your work and don't worry, I'll save up for the down payment as quickly as possible. Soon we'll be living in our new home together! ETHAN(smiling sweetly)Okay, off you go. Haley waves and leaves reluctantly. As soon as she turns away, Ethan's expression instantly changes. ETHAN(cont'd)What a fool!(looking at the bank card)Once I get that recipe award, we won't even be in the same league. Marry me? Not in your wildest dream!
INT. JEWELRY STORE - DAY8 8

Young Haley picks up a ladies' bracelet. YOUNG HALEY(to herself)Mom sold the only keepsake Dad gave her for me. Today is her birthday, but I still haven't saved enough to buy her a bracelet... Young Haley sadly opens her other hand, clutching the dollar bills. Then her eyes light up as she notices the neighboring store.
CLOSE UP on a sign reading "BUYING HAIR! WILL PAY TOP DOLLAR."
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM DOORWAY - DAY9
Young Haley holds a BOX OF COOKIES and BUSHEL OF ROSES, carefully adjusting her hat to hide her SHORT HAIR. She opens the door to find Claire talking with her grandfather, JAY WINBURY (50).
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM - DAY10 10
CLAIREDad, I don't have much time left...
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM DOORWAY - DAY11
Haley freezes, horrified and disbelieving.
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM - DAY12 12

Claire grips her father's arm in distress. CLAIREBut Haley is so young. I’m begging you, please take her in. JAYIn your dreams! You left the family to marry that beggar who died young. Now you expect me to raise your bastard child? Abandon this child, and I'll take you back as my daughter. You will get the world's best medical team to treat you. CLAIRENever! Haley is my only reason for living. Even if I die, I'll never abandon my daughter! JAYThen I no longer have a daughter. Don't contact me again! Jay storms out angrily. Claire tries to grab him but nearly falls from weakness.
CLAIREDad, don't go! Please take Haley! Dad! Seeing her father leave decisively, Claire can no longer hold back her tears.
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM DOORWAY - DAY13
Haley hides as Jay walks away. She wipes her tears forcefully. Taking a deep breath, puts on a smile and pretends nothing happened then opens the door. YOUNG HALEYMom, I'm home!
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM - DAY14 14

Claire quickly wipes away her tears, also pretending as she smiles at Haley. CLAIRESweetheart, you’re back. YOUNG HALEYMom, I saved the prettiest roses for your vase. CLAIREThank you, darling. You always bring mom the loveliest blooms. Haley discards the old roses from the vase and arranges the fresh ones. YOUNG HALEYMom, it's your birthday. I wanted to buy you a bracelet, but I couldn't save enough money... Haley takes out a children's bracelet from her pocket. YOUNG HALEY(cont'd)I could only afford this kid's bracelet... Do you like it? Claire is deeply moved and heartbroken. She nods firmly. CLAIREOf course I like it. You're mommy's biggest pride, this is the best gift I've ever been given.

YOUNG HALEY(excited)That's great! Let me put it on for you! Haley kneels by the bed, carefully fastens the bracelet on Claire's wrist. Seeing this, Claire can't hold back her tears. She turns away, covering her mouth as tears fall. YOUNG HALEY(cont'd)All done! Claire quickly wipes tears and looks at the bracelet, forcing a smile. CLAIREWow, it's beautiful. Thank you, sweetheart. Having you is my greatest blessing. Claire gently touches Haley's hand, notices the bruises. Her eyes fill with tears. CLAIRE(cont'd)I'm so sorry my sweet... I’m sick, making you suffer so much... YOUNG HALEYI'm not suffering at all, but you are. You have to take injections and medicines every day. Mom, today is your birthday, I haven’t made enough money to buy you a birthday cake, but I made you some cookies. Claire feigns a smile and nods through her tears. Haley opens the COOKIE BOX and hands one to Claire. YOUNG HALEY(cont'd)I read that jasmine is good for the stomach. I added jasmine to it, I hope it can makes you feel better. Mom, try one. Claire takes a bite of the cookie Haley feeds her, chewing thoughtfully. Haley watches expectantly. Claire nods enthusiastically, tears in her eyes. CLAIREIt’s so sweet. These are the best cookies I’ve ever eaten.

Haley beams with joy. Claire takes out TWO NECKLACES from under her pillow -- their pendants form a complete heart when joined. CLAIRE(cont'd)Haley, this is the only thing I own now. We'll each take half of it. Here, let me put it on you. Claire splits the necklaces, tries to put one on Haley but notices something odd about her hair. She reaches for Haley's hat. Haley tries to dodge but isn't quick enough. Claire freezes. (ANGLE UP) Claire slowly raises her hand and gently removes Haley's hat, revealing her messily cut, tomboyish short hair. Claire is shocked. CLAIRE(cont'd)Your... your hair... YOUNG HALEYAh, long hair was too hard to wash. Mom, you're not angry, are you? Claire looks at Haley's hair, then at the bracelet on her wrist. Fighting back tears, she tenderly strokes Haley's short hair. CLAIREOf course I'm not angry... Claire puts one necklace on Haley, then puts one on her self. CLAIRE(cont'd)We each take half of the necklace. No matter what happens in the future, I’ll will never leave you. We will stay together, is that okay? YOUNG HALEYOkay! Claire holds Haley tightly, covering her mouth to stifle her sobs while Haley can't see. Haley hugs her back just as tight.
CUT TO:
Claire sleeps peacefully in bed, her hand tightly gripping Haley's. Haley watches her mother sleep, then carefully slips her hand free. She quietly takes Claire's phone and leaves the room.
INT. HALEY'S HOME - LIVING ROOM - DAY15 15
Haley speaks into the phone. YOUNG HALEYGrandpa, please save my mom!
INT. HALEY'S HOME - BEDROOM - NIGHT17 17

Haley places a letter under the rose vase by the bedside table. She watches her sleeping mother and gently kisses Claire's cheek. YOUNG HALEYMom, without me, you'll get better for sure. You must live on. When I become successful, I'll find you and repay all your love in raising me. Haley stands to leave but takes one step and turns back for another look at her mother. Claire remains asleep. Haley steels herself, and reluctantly departs.
CUT TO:

The wind blows the window open, startling Claire awake. She sits up abruptly, gathering her senses, and looks toward the bedroom door. CLAIREHaley? Haley? No response. Claire notices the letter by the bedside table. Confused, she picks it up and opens it. YOUNG HALEY (V.O.)Mom, forgive me for leaving without saying goodbye.

I want to be like other kids, always staying by your side, but I can't let you get worse. Grandpa promised to treat you if I leave. You must get better. Your daughter will pray for you forever. I loves you forever. - Haley
(NOTE: a smiley face is drawn after the word "Mom" in the letter) Claire's tears fall onto the words “I loves you forever." She breaks down sobbing and struggles to get out of bed. CLAIRENo, no...
INT. APARTMENT BUILDING - HALLWAY - NIGHT18

Claire, in her nightgown, clutches her stomach while stumbling along the hallway barefoot, steadying herself against the wall. The necklace against her chest swings with each unsteady step. CLAIRE(crying hysterically)Haley! Haley, where are you? Where are you? Don't leave mommy, Haley... 2 PASSERSBY stare at her strangely, but she doesn't care. CLAIRE(cont'd)Haley! Haley! Claire staggers out of the hallway.

Claire stumbles barefoot in the snow, one hand clutching her stomach, screaming Haley's name with all her strength. CLAIREHaley! Haley, where are you? Don't leave mommy... Haley... Claire staggers, necklace swinging. Suddenly she collapses on the ground, gasping for air. She ignores her body's pain and claws her way forward through the muddy snow, approaching a street corner. CLAIRE(cont'd)Haley... wait for mommy, Haley...

Jay and TWO BODYGUARDS appear behind Claire, next to a luxury car. One Bodyguard is holding a umbrella for Jay. Claire tries to get up but falls again. CLAIRE(cont'd)Haley! Haley! Jay watches her, frowning deeply, and instructs his bodyguards. JAYGet the lady into the car. The Bodyguards pull Claire up from the ground. She struggles. CLAIRELet me go! I need to find my daughter. She's waiting for me! As Claire is dragged up, around the corner, Haley has drawn （Claire's silhouette on the wall with chalk or snow on the ）ground . After finishing, Haley crouches against the wall, positioned as if nestled in Claire's embrace. YOUNG HALEY(whispering)Mom, you have to get better, you have to... Haley hugs herself tightly and falls asleep from the cold, still clutching the necklace her mother gave her. ANGLE UP. The car carrying Claire passes by Haley. Claire looks down, crying, but doesn't see Haley outside the window.
EXT. HAILSBURY GROUP BUILDING ENTRANCE- DAY20

SUPER: "18 Years Later" A luxury car pulls up, and a group of workers stand in two lines, bowing in unison. Claire's assistant, ASHLEY TAYLOR, opens the car door. Claire, dressed in a high-end suit exuding confidence, wears a distinctive half-heart necklace from 18 years ago. Her gaze is determined, her presence commanding, and she steps out of the car gracefully. WORKERSGood morning, Chairwoman. Claire slightly nods. At that moment, 3 JOURNALISTS rush over.

REPORT1Hailsbury Group has become the world’s leading enterprise under your leadership over the past 18 years. Do you have any feelings or thoughts you'd like to share? Claire turns and looks at the reporters with a commanding presence. CLAIREOver the past 18 years, I have overcome the toughest challenges and gained the greatest wealth and power.(looks at the bracelet)Except one thing, that has been my biggest pain and I’ll never let go. Claire takes out her phone. The screen shows a photo of Claire with young Haley (7 years old, with long hair). CLAIRE(cont'd)This girl is Haley Davis, my daughter whom I lost 18 years ago. I've never stopped searching for her, but have found no trace. From today, every branch of Hailsbury in the world will dedicate resources to finding my daughter. If anyone provides any information, I will reward them - with 10 million dollars! The reports and workers are shocked, exclaiming "Wow!" and discussing excitedly. The scene becomes lively with chatter. REPORTER 1What? Ten million just for a lead? REPORTER 2My goodness! CLAIREWhoever finds my daughter will become an honorary director of the Hailsbury Group. Whatever they desire, I will make it happen! The crowd is shocked again, buzzing with discussion. Claire holds her necklace pendant, examining it carefully with a lost expression. CLAIRE (V.O.)My dear daughter, where are you?
INT. EVERFRESH FOOD FACTORY - COURTYARD - DAY21

Haley (25), wearing a work uniform, hands documents to ETHAN WESTON. HALEYEthan! This recipe took me three years to develop... and it’s for you! When you submit it to the group, they'll surely promote you! Ethan takes the documents, barely containing his excitement. ETHANHaley, baby, you're amazing! Such a valuable recipe, you're really giving it to me? HALEY(embarrassed)I'm just an ordinary worker, and I don't know much else. If you hadn't saved me six years ago, I might not even exist in this world... Ethan gently places his hands on Haley's shoulders, comforting her. ETHANNo, Haley. You may have amnesia, but you must have been a genius before. This recipe you gave me will definitely win awards. Once the group recognizes me, we'll get married. HALEY(delighted)Okay! ETHANBy the way, Haley baby, about the $50,000 down payment for our house... how much have you saved for it? Ethan gazes at Haley lovingly.
INT. HAILSBURY GROUP - HALLWAY - DAY23 23
(Note: Claire wears the same outfit until the end and the necklace is always under her clothes, but only revealed to viewers at the end).

Claire walks while checking her bracelet, showing a faint smile. At the corner, she bumps into ASHLEY, who drops her stack of documents. ASHLEYI'm sorry, Ms. Winbury. I wasn't paying attention... CLAIREIt's fine, I wasn't watching where I was going. Any news about my daughter? ASHLEYNot yet... Claire looks disappointed, then notices a document on the floor, her eyes lighting up. Close-up on title: "Multivitamin Probiotic Liquid Salad." There’s also a Haley’s signature smiley face on it. Claire picks up the document, reads it carefully. CLAIREWhere... where did this recipe come from? ASHLEYThese are patent proposals collected from branch companies under our food division.(looking at the recipe)This one came from a factory called EverFresh in Portville. Claire remains excited, looking at the recipe in her hands, lost in memory.
INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY 24 24
The DOCTOR advises Claire. DOCTORWith late-stage stomach cancer, there aren’t many foods you can eat. But insufficient nutrition will worsen your condition.

Try to eat foods with probiotics that are easily digestible and rich in vitamins. Young Haley, looking innocent, comforts Claire. YOUNG HALEYMom, when I grow up, I'll develop a liquid salad that has probiotics and lots of vitamins, and it'll be really sweet too! When mom can't eat anything else, she can just drink that!
INT. HAILSBURY GROUP - HALLWAY - DAY25 25

Claire looks at the recipe excitedly. CLAIREWhen Haley was little, she said she'd develop a drink that could help people with stomach cancer. And this smiley face... Claire takes out Haley's farewell letter from her wallet with trembling hands. The letter has the same smiley face on it. Claire and Ashley exchange smiles. CLAIRE(cont'd)(tears in her eyes)It's her, it's my daughter! Quick, prepare the car. I'm going to find my daughter now!
INT. HAILSBURY GROUP - LOBBY - DAY26 26

4 SECURITY GUARDS line up in two rows. Ashley takes a gun from GUARD A and addresses all guards. ASHLEYI heard that Portville is not safe. I need everyone to stay alert and ensure the Ms. Winbury’s safety at all times. ALL GUARDSYes ma’am!!

In the front seat, Secretary Ashley reports to Claire. ASHLEYChairwoman, we're about half an hour from our destination. The food company headquarters just informed us they've identified the recipe's inventor. CLAIREIs it Haley? ASHLEYIt's a man, named Ethan Weston. Claire's looks disappointed. Ashley continues reading from her iPad. ASHLEY(cont'd)His father is the deputy floor supervisor at EverFresh Food Factory.(turning a page)Oh, and he has a girlfriend. They’ve been together six years. CLAIRE(seeing hope)Girlfriend? What's her name? ASHLEY(searching for the name)It's... Haley Davis! CLAIRE(excited)What? Haley Davis? ASHLEYMs. Winbury, please don't get too excited. Many people have pretended to be your daughter over the years. We can't confirm she's your daughter just based on a name.(checking documents, surprised)Oh, this girl also works at EverFresh, and she's donated to their blood drive recently! I'll arrange for DNA testing immediately.

CLAIRENo matter what, I’m happy with the recipe. Make this awards ceremony grander than ever before. Increase Ethan Weston's bonus from 10 thousand to one million. Also, promote his father to Deputy Manager of the factory. ASHLEYYes, Ms. Winbury. I'll arrange it right away. Claire looks at her bracelet and gently touches it. CLAIREHaley, Could it be you? Mommy misses your roses. I’d love to get them from you again... Just then, Claire looks out the window and her eyes brighten. Haley, is selling roses from a cart. CLAIRE(cont'd)Stop the car!
EXT. STREET - DAY28 28

Haley waves goodbye to a customer who just bought flowers. HALEYPlease come again! Claire happily approaches Haley's flower stand. CLAIREIt's so cold today. How can a young girl like you still be selling flowers outside? Your family must be really worried. HALEY(smiling)It's fine. I'm getting married to my boyfriend soon, but we're still short 10 thousand for our house’s down payment. So I’m doing several jobs after my regular work hours. CLAIREWhat jobs do you have besides selling flowers?

HALEYAfter I finish selling flowers, I work at a burger joint, and after that, I clean at a bar. The night shift pays better. I'll do anything for us to live in our own home sooner. CLAIRE(eyes twinkling)I can see how much you love him. You know, my daughter would be about your age. I wonder if she's found someone she loves... Claire picks up a bouquet. CLAIRE(cont'd)I'll buy all of these then! HALEYThank you! But... the one in your hand... I was saving it specially for my boyfriend. Haley looks embarrassed. Claire looks at the fresh flowers in her hand, moved as she remembers her daughter's words. YOUNG HALEY (V.O.)Mom, I saved today's prettiest roses to put in your vase. CLAIREYou're such a lovely girl. I hope you can marry to your boyfriend soon. Claire takes out her wallet to pay. Haley's smiling expression suddenly turns to surprise. She notices the children's bracelet on Claire's wrist. Cut between the bracelet and Haley's surprised expression.
EXT. STREET - DAY - CONTINUOUS29 29
Haley stares at the bracelet, hesitating. HALEYThat bracelet... why does it look so familiar...

Claire puts several bills in the cart's money box. Then she looks at the puzzled Haley. CLAIREWhat's wrong? HALEY(snapping out of it)Nothing, nothing. Here, ma’am, let me throw in some homemade cookies. I hope you don't mind. Haley hands over a package of cookies. CLAIREThank you, young lady. Claire and her group leave. Haley smiles as she watches them go, then looks down and notices a check tucked between the bills. Haley opens the check and discovers it's for ten thousand dollars, surprised. HALEYOh no, ma’am, this is too much! Haley runs after them with the money, but the car has already started leaving. HALEY(cont'd)I have to find her and return this money to her. Just then, a female coworker in factory uniform, JENNA JONES, runs up. JENNAHaley, quick, back to the factory! Headquarters just announced that the Innovative Foods awards ceremony is happening today. Your boyfriend is going to be the star of the whole factory! HALEY(delighted)Really? Ethan's getting the award today? Oh my god, that means he's going to propose to me today... JENNAYes, let's hurry! Jenna and Haley run off, pushing the cart.
INT. CAR - DAY30 30
Claire looks at the cookies in her hand, remembering the past.

Claire nods happily through her tears. Haley opens the cookie box and hands one to Claire. YOUNG HALEYI read that jasmine is good for the stomach. I added lots of jasmine, so when your tummy hurts and you can't eat, these cookies will help you feel better. Try one, Mom. Is it good? Claire takes a bite of the cookie Haley feeds her, chewing thoughtfully. Haley watches expectantly. Claire nods enthusiastically, tears in her eyes. CLAIRESweet and crunchy. These are the best cookies mom has ever tasted. Haley beams with joy.
INT. CAR - DAY - CONTINUOUS31 31

Claire looks at the cookies, somewhat sad. CLAIREHaley Baby, mommy miss you so much... Claire holds back her sadness, takes out a cookie to look at it, then puts it in her mouth. After two chews, her expression changes. CLAIRE(cont'd)This taste... Claire looks at the cookie in surprise, then becomes extremely excited. CLAIRE(cont'd)This is the taste of jasmine! It's Haley! Quick, turn around, go back to where we bought the flowers right now!
EXT. STREET - DAY32 32

Claire gets out of the car, runs to where the flower stand was, but finds it empty. CLAIRE(panicked)Haley! Haley! Where did she go?! ASHLEYMs. Winbury, she was wearing an EverFresh factory uniform. The Innovative Foods awards ceremony is today, everyone from the EverFresh factory has to attend. CLAIREYes, you're right. To the factory, right now! Claire hurries back to the car.
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY33 33

Factory workshop environment. Cold dishes and wine. The backdrop, banners, and stands read "HAILSBURY GROUP & EVERFRESH FACTORY - INNOVATIVE FOODS AWARDS CEREMONY". 20 GUESTS are present - 10 in factory uniforms and 10 in formal attire, chatting in small groups. Ethan, wearing a suit, stands below the stage, accepting flattery from guests. GUEST 1Mr. Weston, The Hailsbury Group’s arranged such a grand feast to celebrate your recipe. The chairwoman must really value your abilities! ETHAN(pleased)Just randomly threw something together. Never thought the chairwoman would like it. I consider myself lucky. GUEST 2Getting an award for just "throwing something together"? Mr. Weston, you're a genius! Your future is limitless!

Ethan basks in the praise as others nod in agreement. MARISSA WESTON (45, Ethan's mother) comes over. MARISSAMy son has been smart since he was young. He is much brighter than most people. GRACE WESTON (25, Ethan's sister) chimes in. GRACEExactly! This recipe is just my brother testing the waters. Once he gets serious, with his abilities, he'll definitely get promoted to corporate headquarters! Ethan holds his head high proudly as others nod in agreement. CROWD(overlapping)That's right! / So admirable! Claire and Ashley enter the banquet hall. Ashley points at Ethan. ASHLEYMrs. Winbury, that's Ethan Weston. Claire looks at Ethan with an approving smile, then slightly furrows her brow. CLAIREWhere's his girlfriend? The girl called Haley? Claire and Ashley scan the crowd. Haley runs in carrying the bouquet of roses, wiping sweat from her forehead. She immediately spots Ethan talking among the crowd. Haley gazes at Ethan adoringly, her expression full of worship and pride. HALEYEthan looks so handsome today... Soon he'll propose to me in front of everyone. I'm so blessed... Haley dusts off her work uniform, looks at the flowers in her hands, smiles determinedly, and walks toward Ethan. Ashley notices Haley passing by and alerts Claire.

ASHLEYMs. Winbury, look! It's that flower-selling girl! Claire's eyes light up as she looks at Haley. Haley makes her way through the crowd, waving to Ethan. HALEYEthan, I'm here! Hearing Haley's voice, Ethan doesn't even look at her, turning instead to walk onto the stage. Ethan taps his wine glass, drawing everyone's attention as they quiet down and gather around the stage. He flashes a confident smile. ETHANGood evening everyone. Welcome to my award ceremony. To be honest, for all I’ve achieved till now... I must especially thank one woman who has supported me all these years. The crowd applauds. Haley, hearing this, breaks into a shy smile. ETHAN(cont'd)Without her brilliant idea and help, I could never have reached the heights I have today. She is my everything, someone I would protect with my life forever! So on this special day, I want to express my gratitude to her. Haley's close coworkers, JENNA JONES and LILA LEIGH (40-50s), exchange knowing glances, happy for her. JENNAThese six years haven't been easy for Haley. To save for the house down payment, She’s been working 24/7, she has like four jobs! LILAYes, besides working here, she’s been selling flowers, waiting tables, and staying up late researching recipes. Look at her hands, they are always bright red from the cold! Haley, hearing her coworkers, bashfully rubs her hands.

JENNAHaley's a good girl. She's finally made it through. I'm so happy for her. ETHANToday, I not only want to thank her, but I, Ethan Weston, want to propose to her! I will spend my life protecting her, cherishing her! The crowd applauds, gathers around Haley, who looks shyly toward Ethan with anticipation. Claire is moved, exchanging smiles with Ashley as they applaud. ETHAN(cont'd)This girl is-- Haley can barely contain her smile as she prepares to step forward. ETHAN(cont'd)Miss Vanessa! Vanessa Nelson! Haley freezes, her smile vanishing. Claire's smile also fades, confused. Others exchange bewildered looks. Ethan steps down from the stage, inviting Vanessa up. The crowd murmurs in disbelief. VANESSA NELSON (25) enters the banquet hall wearing a beautiful evening gown. She deliberately bumps Haley hard when passing her, then putting on an sweet expression walks onto the stage, placing her hand in Ethan's. Ethan kisses Vanessa. Through their kissing scene, Haley watches in disbelief, clutching her chest in extreme pain. JENNAWhat... how could this happen? The crowd looks at Haley as she staggers backward, watching the couple on stage. Claire's eyes are full of sympathy.
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY - CONTINUOUS34 34
Vanessa pulls away and playfully pushes Ethan. He holds her hand, deeply affectionate. ETHANI could never win this award without Vanessa's support.

Babe, you gave me direction when I was lost. You spent three years tirelessly helping me research recipes. Without you, I wouldn't have this honor today. VANESSADarling, it's nothing. After all, we're so in love. HALEYWhat are you saying... That recipe... I was the one who helped you with it. Haley stares blankly in disbelief, looking up at Ethan. On stage, Ethan raises Vanessa's hand, gesturing to the crowd. ETHANVanessa and I have decided to hold our wedding in three days! Ethan lifts Vanessa's hand, her diamond ring sparkling. Haley's face shows deep hurt. Claire is also shocked. The workers are stunned. JENNAGetting married? LILAWhat? They are getting married? The crowd whispers. Someone recognizes Vanessa. GUEST 1I know, she is Miss Nelson! The niece of the factory manager! Haley looks at Guest 1, who continues. Ethan intimately embraces Vanessa. GUEST 1(cont'd)I remember she graduated from Harvard University. She's educated and beautiful - Such a match for Mr. Weston! GUEST 2Not just that, I heard that Miss Nelson's father is the vice president of the Portsville branch of Hailsbury Group! She's only works here just for the namesake.

GUEST 3My goodness, that Ethan’s really married into a wealthy family! HALEYIt can’t be! Haley's fights back tears, turning to protest. Nearby, the previously happy Marissa and Grace look at Haley with disgust. HALEY(cont'd)Ethan said he would marry me. There must be some misunderstanding. GRACE(pushing Haley away)What’s there to misunderstand? A poor nobody like you wanting to marry my brother - that's the real misunderstanding! MARISSAExactly! I'm warning you, if you dare to make a scene here, I'll break your legs! HALEYNo, that’s impossible, I need to ask Ethan myself! Ignoring Marissa and Grace's attempts to stop her, Haley rushes to the stage. HALEY(cont'd)Ethan, is there a mistake? Didn't you promise to marry me? Vanessa looks displeased as she looks at Ethan.
